'''Erriya''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] who was a former member of the [[Myyydril]] tribe and resident of the [[Myyydril Caverns/Legends|Myyydril Caverns]] within the [[Kkowir Forest/Legends|Kkowir Forest]] on his homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. His entire left arm was [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] as the result of experiments performed on him by [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Nycolai Kinesworthy]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Erriya appears in the [[2005]] expansion pack to ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' entitled ''Rage of the Wookiees'' prior to the games closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
